FuryFromTheDelve.description: <style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Hâvyr's</style> <style="NormalAttack">normal attacks</style> <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppress</style> enemies that are at more than <style="Stat_Health">{[hpPct]}% Health</style>.
